d: Job Description – Hub Lead (E-Commerce Fulfillment Centre)
Job Title: Hub Lead – Fulfillment Centre
Reports To: Operations Manager / General Manager – E-Commerce
We are seeking a highly motivated, customer-focused, and results-driven Hub Lead to manage the day-to-day operations of our E-Commerce Fulfillment Centre.

The Hub Lead will be responsible for overseeing inbound, inventory management, order processing, picking, packing, dispatch, and returns while ensuring operational efficiency, inventory accuracy, and exceptional customer service.

The ideal candidate should possess strong leadership skills, hands-on warehouse management experience, excellent communication abilities, and the ability to manage high-volume e-commerce fulfillment operations while consistently meeting customer expectations and service-level agreements (SLAs).
Oversee daily warehouse operations, including inbound receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, dispatch, and returns.
Ensure all customer orders are processed accurately and dispatched within agreed SLAs.
Plan and allocate manpower based on daily order volumes and operational requirements.
Monitor daily productivity and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
Ensure smooth coordination between warehouse operations, customer service, and last-mile delivery teams.
Manage peak-season operations and fluctuations in order volumes without compromising service quality.
Act as the primary operational point of contact for assigned customers.
Deliver exceptional customer service by ensuring timely communication, proactive problem-solving, and effective complaint resolution.
Understand individual customer requirements and ensure fulfillment operations are aligned with their expectations.
Respond promptly and professionally to customer inquiries, operational concerns, and escalations.
Build strong customer relationships through consistent service delivery and transparency.
Coordinate with internal teams to resolve order discrepancies, delivery delays, and inventory-related issues.
Provide regular operational updates to customers and management.
Maintain accurate inventory records using the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
Supervise stock receiving, SKU identification, barcode scanning, and put-away activities.
Conduct regular cycle counts and inventory reconciliations.
Ensure proper stock rotation using FIFO/FEFO principles where applicable.
Maintain warehouse cleanliness, organization, and compliance with safety standards.
Lead, supervise, and motivate warehouse associates, pickers, packers, and operational staff.
Assign daily responsibilities and monitor individual and team performance.
Conduct regular team briefings and operational reviews.
Train team members on WMS processes, SOPs, customer requirements, and operational best practices.
Address performance issues and implement corrective actions.
Promote accountability, teamwork, discipline, and a customer-first culture.
Ensure all warehouse transactions are accurately recorded in the WMS.
Monitor inbound and outbound order processing through the system.
Ensure barcode scanning compliance across warehouse operations.
Coordinate with the IT team to resolve system-related issues.
Support integrations with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, Amazon, Noon, WooCommerce, and Magento.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.
Coordinate with last-mile delivery partners to ensure timely order collection and dispatch.
Monitor delivery performance and proactively address delays.
Ensure accurate handover documentation and shipment tracking.
Coordinate failed deliveries, returns, and reverse logistics.
Work closely with courier partners to maintain agreed delivery SLAs.
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational performance reports.
Monitor order processing accuracy, dispatch performance, inventory accuracy, and manpower productivity.
Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective measures.
Track customer complaints, investigate root causes, and implement preventive actions.
Recommend improvements to reduce operational costs and increase productivity.

Designing engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences that develop reading, writing, critical thinking and communication skills
Assessing student work using MYP Business Studies criteria and providing meaningful, constructive feedback
Creating units of inquiry that explore language, literature, global contexts and intercultural perspectives
Embedding ATL skills and a genuine love of reading and language throughout all aspects of teaching
Supporting students' preparation for MYP eAssessment in Business Studies
Fulfilling Form Tutor responsibilities and contributing to the pastoral life of the school
Contributing positively to the English department and the wider EGA school community
A recognised teaching qualification (PGCE, QTS, B.Ed or equivalent) and a degree in English, Language & Literature or a related subject
Proven experience teaching Language & Literature or English in an IB MYP school
Strong knowledge of the MYP Language & Literature curriculum, assessment criteria and eAssessment
Excellent literacy skills and a genuine passion for language and literature
Ability to design and deliver concept-driven, inquiry-based and differentiated lessons
Effective classroom management and communication skills
A commitment to safeguarding and student wellbeing
